contact.title: Talk to the Atlas team
contact.description: Questions about plans, moving an existing academy, or working together? Send us a message and we will reply by email.

points.reply: Every message is read by a person on the Atlas team.
points.privacy: We use your details only to reply to you.
points.privacyWithConsent: We use your details to reply to you, and for anything more only if you tick a box below.

form.label: Contact the Atlas team
form.name: Your name
form.privacyNote: We reply to the email address you enter here.
form.whatsappHint: Only if you would like us to reply on WhatsApp.

contact.foundingHint: Applying as a Founding Academy? Tell us your academy's name, roughly how many students you teach and when you would like to start. We set up to 5 academies a week, in the order requests arrive.

errors.emailInvalid: Enter a valid email address, like name@company.com.
errors.messageTooShort: Tell us a little more — at least {{messageMin}} characters.

success.title: Message sent
success.description: Thank you — we have received your message and will reply by email.

failure.title: Your message was not sent
failure.description: Something went wrong on our side or with the connection. Your text is still here — please try again.
failure.rateLimited: You have sent several messages in a short time. Please wait a few minutes, then try again.

consent.contactConsent: You may contact me about this enquiry by email, phone or WhatsApp.
